purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign086, before opening any Campaign087 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It compares the full 240-position participation distributions of contemporaneous intrabar log range and transaction amount. It is not a Pearson level association, a single peak-time match, or amount alignment with adjacent close returns.
Campaign018 already freezes contemporaneous log-range/log1p-share-volume Pearson confirmation; substituting amount or another monotone transform would be a nearby rescue.
Campaign082 already freezes last-maximum timing alignment and amount center-of-mass is also terminal.
Campaign053 already freezes amount versus absolute adjacent close-return Jensen-Shannon alignment.
Subwindow, threshold, filter, rank, weighting, transform, subset, regime, fitted, model, and combination searches are outside the one-factor finite catalog.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_range_amount_profile_alignment_js_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When the minute-by-minute distribution of intrabar auction width is supported by the same distribution of transaction value, price discovery is less concentrated in thin prints and may leave a more persistent completed-session information state over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: On the exact 240 selected bars let r_i=ln(high_i/low_i), R=sum_i r_i, p_i=r_i/R, A=sum_i amount_i, q_i=amount_i/A, and m_i=(p_i+q_i)/2. Let JSD=0.5*sum_{p_i>0} p_i*ln(p_i/m_i)+0.5*sum_{q_i>0} q_i*ln(q_i/m_i). Return 1-JSD/ln(2).
selected_candidate.time_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. The raw 09:30 row remains required by source identity but is excluded. No transition, lunch pair, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock observation is formed.
selected_candidate.input_rule: Every selected high, low, and amount must be finite; high and low must be strictly positive with low<=high; amount must be nonnegative. Exact zero range and exact zero amount remain valid components.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require strictly positive finite total log range R and strictly positive finite total amount A. No minimum nonzero-bar count or activity threshold is allowed.
selected_candidate.zero_rule: For either distribution define every zero-probability contribution as exactly zero. A positive probability always has positive mixture mass, so no pseudocount, smoothing, jitter, or replacement is used.
selected_candidate.floating_point_rule: Use natural-log float64 arithmetic. Canonicalize only a final score within 1e-12 of zero or one; otherwise require it to lie in [0,1] without clipping.
selected_candidate.availability: Known at the signal-session close after the exact 240 selected bars; no later session, daily return, comparison value, or Candidate49 observation is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
